description: Search humanitarian reports on ReliefWeb with filtering by country, disaster, format, theme, language, source, and date. Returns paginated summaries — use reliefweb_get_report to fetch full body text. Report body is excluded from results (10–100KB each); call get_report when document content is needed. Every report is reachable by default — reports have no archived class, so include_archived has no effect here. Note: each call counts against the 1,000 calls/day quota.

country.description: One or more ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes in any case, separated by commas or spaces (e.g., SYR, or SYR,AFG). Filters to content tagged with every listed country. A country name or two-letter code is rejected; find the code with reliefweb_list_countries text. Blank is omitted.

anyOf.description: Calendar date (2024-01-15) or full ISO 8601 datetime (2024-01-15T00:00:00+00:00).

date_from.description: Earliest publication date. Filters on date.original (source publication date). A bare calendar date such as 2024-01-15 is accepted and resolves to start of that day in UTC; a datetime carrying any offset is resolved to UTC.

anyOf.description: Calendar date (2024-01-31) or full ISO 8601 datetime (2024-01-31T23:59:59+00:00).

date_to.description: Latest publication date. Pair with date_from for a date range. A bare calendar date resolves to end of that day in UTC, so the range covers it in full; a datetime carrying any offset is resolved to UTC.

disaster_id.description: ReliefWeb numeric disaster ID. Filters to reports linked to a specific disaster. Get the ID from reliefweb_search_disasters.

filter.description: Raw ReliefWeb filter object for compound conditions not covered by named params. Example: {"operator": "AND", "conditions": [{"field": "format.name", "value": "Map"}, {"field": "language.code", "value": "fr"}]}.

format.description: Content format filter. One of: News and Press Release, Situation Report, Map, Infographic, Analysis, Other, Assessment, Manual and Guideline, Appeal, UN Document, Evaluation and Lessons Learned. Case, spacing, and punctuation are ignored; any other value is rejected with the valid list.

include_archived.description: No effect on reports. Reports have no archived class — every report is already in scope, whatever this is set to. Kept so existing calls that pass it keep working; it is meaningful on reliefweb_search_jobs, reliefweb_search_training, and reliefweb_search_disasters.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code (e.g., en, fr, es, ar). Case-insensitive; sent lower-cased, the form ReliefWeb stores. Filters on language.code.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–1000, default 10). Larger integers are clamped to 1000 with a notice when clamping is enabled; otherwise they are rejected. Use a smaller value for targeted lookups; larger for bulk research. Each call counts against the 1,000-calls/day quota.

offset.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Use with limit and the totalCount enrichment field to page through large result sets.

sort.description: Sort order. Use date.original:desc for newest first (default), date.original:asc for oldest first, score:desc for relevance.

source.description: Organization short name (e.g., UNHCR, OCHA, WFP). Filters on source.shortname.

text.description: Full-text search query. Matches against title, body, and key metadata fields. Use plain natural language or keywords.

theme.description: Sector or cross-cutting theme. One of: Protection and Human Rights, Health, Food and Nutrition, Shelter and Non-Food Items, Water Sanitation Hygiene, Agriculture, Coordination, Education, Contributions, Recovery and Reconstruction, Peacekeeping and Peacebuilding, Logistics and Telecommunications, Disaster Management, Safety and Security, Climate Change and Environment, Gender, Camp Coordination and Camp Management, Mine Action, HIV/Aids, Humanitarian Financing. Also accepts the abbreviations WASH, CCCM, NFI, and a word found in only one theme name (Protection resolves to Protection and Human Rights). Separate several themes with commas to require all of them. Case, spacing, and punctuation are ignored; any other value is rejected with the valid list. Matches whole theme tags.

name: reliefweb_search_reports

appliedFilters.description: The resolved filter set the query actually ran with, after normalization and defaults. Echoes back so the agent can confirm how its inputs were interpreted.

country.description: Country codes as normalized: uppercased ISO3, comma-separated when several.

format.description: Format name filter applied, in its canonical ReliefWeb spelling.

preset.description: ReliefWeb preset the query used. Always latest for reports — no preset changes which reports match.

rawFilter.description: True when a raw compound filter object was merged into the query.

sort.description: Sort order the query used (resolved, including the default).

theme.description: Theme names applied, in canonical ReliefWeb spelling and comma-separated when several (reports must carry every one).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date`: A date bound contains impossible calendar or time components. `unknown_format`: The format value does not name a ReliefWeb report format. `unknown_theme`: A theme value names no single ReliefWeb theme — an unknown name, a word shared by several theme names, or words from more than one. `invalid_query`: ReliefWeb rejected the query — possible causes include malformed text, an unrecognized sort field, an invalid raw filter object, or a malformed date. `upstream_error`: The ReliefWeb API was unreachable, timed out, or returned a server error. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: Matching reports (summaries only — use reliefweb_get_report for full body).

countries.description: All countries tagged on this report.

countryIso3s.description: Uppercase ISO3 codes of the countries tagged on this report — the form the country filters and reliefweb_get_country take.

disasters.description: Disasters ReliefWeb links this report to. Absent when the report links none.

items.description: A disaster this report is linked to.

glide.description: GLIDE number, when the disaster has one.

id.description: ReliefWeb disaster ID — pass it to reliefweb_get_disaster, or as disaster_id to reliefweb_search_reports for the reports on the same disaster.

fileUrls.description: Direct file download URLs attached to this report.

headlineSummary.description: Short editorial summary from the headline block, when present.

primaryCountry.description: Primary country name for this report.

primaryCountryIso3.description: Uppercase ISO3 code of the primary country — the form the country filters and reliefweb_get_country take.

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this report.

notice.description: Discloses requested and applied limits when clamped, an ignored empty raw filter, and empty-page guidance with the match count and last reachable offset or suggestions to broaden the search.

totalCount.description: Total reports matching the query before pagination.

title: Search ReliefWeb Reports
